maddeler.e:
نعتزل (form VIII)
# نَعْتَزِلُ (naʕtazilu) /naʕ.ta.zi.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِعْتَزَلَ (iʕtazala)
# نُعْتَزَلُ (nuʕtazalu) /nuʕ.ta.za.lu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَزَلَ (iʕtazala)
# نَعْتَزِلَ (naʕtazila) /naʕ.ta.zi.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِعْتَزَلَ (iʕtazala)
# نُعْتَزَلَ (nuʕtazala) /nuʕ.ta.za.la/:
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
